content_blocks.title: Reference example: Negative Caching and Cache Penetration
content_blocks.code:
SET cache:product:42 "{\"name\":\"keyboard\"}" EX 60
TTL cache:product:42
GET cache:product:42
content_blocks.run_instructions: The primary database remains the source of truth in this example; define invalidation and stale-data policy explicitly.
content_blocks.note: Use a disposable development keyspace. Treat this as a learning example, not a production-ready policy without boundary tests.
